# Valmet

> > Global leader in process technologies, automation systems, and services for the pulp, paper, and energy industries, featuring Neles flow control solutions.

Valmet delivers industrial technologies and services to customers worldwide, with major installations at facilities like Arauco in Brazil, Södra Cell Mörrum, and Ranheim Paper & Board in Norway. The company specializes in sustainable solutions for pulp mills, paper and board machines, energy automation, and valve control systems.

## Key Topics

- Pulp industry technologies
- Paper and board manufacturing
- Energy automation systems
- Neles flow control solutions
- Pneumatic actuators (B1, N1, Quadra-Powr series)
- Sustainability in industrial processes
- Pulp mill operations
- Production capacity optimization
- Industrial valve automation
- Corporate training and development
- Process rebuilds and upgrades
- Customer service excellence
- Finland and Norway operations
- Customized industrial solutions
